transcript.content: After getting caught in rain and splashed by a car during a run, I developed persistent negative thoughts and emotions that affected my mood that day and my view of the experience, and further affected my work, social life, and daily life.
[System A Baseline] 我听到了您的陈述：“在一次跑步中遭遇下雨与被汽车溅湿后，产生并持续了负性思维和情绪，影响当天整体心情”。请继续分享您的想法。
